description: A redirect to https://attacker.example\@shop.example.com/catalog: the WHATWG URL parser reads "\" as "/" in an https URL, so the host is attacker.example (path /@shop.example.com/catalog), an origin outside the allowlist: a normal page, no snapshot, no error. A parser that reads "attacker.example\" as user information sees shop.example.com and fails this case (DL-040 L-3)
